articles.title: Who is Zinedine Zidane’s wife? Everything you need to know about Veronique Zidane, France's greatest football icon's life partner
articles.description: Veronique Zidane, born Veronique Fernandez Lentisco on November 10, 1971, in Rodez, France, is the wife of newly appointed France head coach Zinedine Zidane. Of Spanish-Andalusian descent, she pursued dance at the prestigious Rosella Hightower School in Cannes before stepping away from professional life to raise the couple's four sons, all of whom went on to play professional football. She and Zinedine met in 1989 in Salon-de-Provence and married in 1994. Known for maintaining a deliberately private life with no verified social media presence, Veronique has remained a foundational but quiet figure throughout one of football's most celebrated careers

articles.title: Vishal's Makutam Unveils the Soulful New Song "Kalatheylaa"
articles.description: Makutam, the 99th production of Super Good Films, stars Vishal in the lead while also marking his directorial venture. Produced under the banner of the late R.B. Choudary, the film features Anjali and Dushara Vijayan as the female leads. The teaser, first single "The Rise of Linga," and the folk number "Nachake Vachera" have already raised expectations for the film. Continuing the momentum, the makers have now released another beautiful track titled "Kalatheylaa." "Kalatheylaa" is an emotional family-oriented motivational song that highlights heartwarming moments featuring Vishal, Dushara Vijayan, and children. Penned by Rajashree Sudhakar and sung by Krishna Tejasvi, the song is elevated by G.V. Prakash Kumar's catchy and soulful composition. With its appealing melody and emotional visuals, the song is expected to strike a chord with audiences and trend widely on YouTube. The film's cinematography is handled by Richard M. Nathan and Abhinandan Ramanujam, while N.B. Srikanth serves as the editor. The makers are expected to announce the film's release date soon. Cast : Vishal, Anjali, Dushara Vijayan, John Vijay, Jayaprakash, Ajay, Vamsi Krishna, Abu Salim, Arjai, Jhansi, Padam Kumar, Sabumon and others. Technical Crew: Banner: Super Good Films Producers: B. Suresh, R.B. Jeevan Choudary, Jithan Ramesh, Jeeva Presented by: R.B. Choudary Screenplay & Director: Vishal Directors of Photography: Richard M. Nathan & Abhinandan Ramanujam Music: G.V. articles.title: ‘Ramayana’, ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Trailers to Play With Tom Holland’s ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’: Report
articles.description:
As excitement continues to build over the Ramayana trailer, word has emerged that it will be screened alongside Spider-Man: Brand New Day, set to hit theatres in India on July 30. Adding to that, the trailer for Marvel’s Avengers: Doomsday is also set to accompany the same release. The news arrives after producer Namit Malhotra hinted that the trailer drop was imminent.

“We just announced, a while before the panel, that Sony Pictures Entertainment is going to be distributing Ramayana globally. That obviously means the trailer is hot on its heels. We showed the trailer at the panel, and I think we’ll be launching it very, very soon. So stay tuned,” he said in an interview with The Climax India.

The producer added, “It could be any day.”

Ahead of its release, the trailer, running past the two-minute mark, has already been leaked online, drawing excited reactions from fans over the introductory scenes of Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi.

‘Ramayana’, ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Trailers

Film critic Taran Adarsh broke the news on his X (formerly Twitter) account, noting that both trailers would be shown ahead of the film’s screening.

Spider-Man: Brand New Day’s Advance Booking

The film has crossed 8 lakh tickets in advance sales on BookMyShow, pushing past the previous record set by Deadpool and Wolverine. Ticket bookings have picked up considerably in recent days, climbing from roughly 43,000 sold on July 17 to a high of 141,000 on July 26

Spider-Man: Brand New Day has already sold around 3.19 lakh tickets, bringing in a total of Rs 16 crore.

Brand New Day picks up the story after No Way Home, in a world where Peter Parker’s identity as Spider-Man has been erased from public memory. The film arrives five months ahead of Avengers: Doomsday, laying the groundwork for the next major superhero crossover. Doomsday, directed by the Russo Brothers, marks Robert Downey Jr’s return - this time suited in green rather than red, as he takes on the role of Dr Victor Von Doom.
